definitions.gloss: depreciation; writing off an asset over time
definitions.explanation: Spreading the cost of a long-lived asset such as a building, machine, or vehicle across the years it is used, instead of treating the whole purchase as an expense at once.

examples.japanese: {減価償却|げんかしょうきゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五年|ごねん}⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧{減価償却|げんかしょうきゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This machine is depreciated over five years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{減価償却費|げんかしょうきゃくひ}→減価償却費：30225_genkashoukyakuhi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Depreciation expense on the building is recorded as a cost every year.

examples.japanese: {減価償却|げんかしょうきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Equipment that has been fully depreciated can often still be used perfectly well.

notes:
Formed from {減価|げんか} (decline in value) + ⟦{償却|しょうきゃく}→償却：30224_shoukyaku⟧ (writing off). Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb, and combines with ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ in ⟦{減価償却費|げんかしょうきゃくひ}→減価償却費：30225_genkashoukyakuhi⟧ (depreciation expense), which is what actually appears on the income statement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {減価償却|げんかしょうきゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to depreciate an asset
- ⟦{減価償却費|げんかしょうきゃくひ}→減価償却費：30225_genkashoukyakuhi⟧: depreciation expense
- {減価償却|げんかしょうきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる: to be fully depreciated

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{償却|しょうきゃく}→償却：30224_shoukyaku⟧: writing off — the broader term, also used for debts
- ⟦{耐用年数|たいようねんすう}→耐用年数：21308_taiyounensuu⟧: useful life — the number of years used for the calculation
- ⟦{原価|げんか}→原価：05470_genka⟧: cost price — the cost of producing goods, unrelated despite the similar sound
